summary: The flat 2D vector visuals are consistent, colorful, and clean across all scenes. However, some character scale inconsistencies and a visual mismatch on the glass mate shot weaken the presentation.

clean: Mate close-ups accurately represent calabaza, madera, and acero textures.
Counter and background alignment in kitchen shots is stable.
unclean: Shot 3: Figure is disproportionately tiny compared to the large room and background elements.
Shot 8: Visual shows numbered flashcards instead of illustrating a glass mate as narrated.

clean: Consistent typography, banners, and color palette throughout.
Clear iconography and well-rendered isolated prop shots.
unclean: Shot 7: Stray visual artifacts or debris scattered on the ground around figures.

issues.problem: Grandma character appears undersized in a vast interior.
issues.fix: Scale character up to occupy roughly one-half to two-thirds of frame height.

issues.problem: Shows numbered cards instead of showing the glass mate described.
issues.fix: Display an illustrated glass mate prop showing yerba through transparency.

issues.problem: Unintended floating gray specks on the street ground layer.
issues.fix: Clean up stray vector particles from the background layer.

learnings.rule: Avoid placing isolated, shrunken full-body figures in oversized empty rooms.
Ensure featured material types are directly depicted rather than abstracted as numbered cards.
